goal: Build a monitored application with useful health signals and verified alerts.
Build an SLO dashboard with transparent calculations and controlled failure evidence.
Build scheduled backups and prove that application data can be restored.
Build repeatable health checks and validate a service recovery runbook.
Instrument multiple services and locate an injected failure using correlated evidence.
Build a canary delivery workflow with deterministic health gates and tested rollback.
Build an evidence workspace supporting incident timelines and verified recovery.
Build a dependency test environment and improve timeout and recovery behaviour.
Build repeatable reliability tests and use measured results to gate a release.
Restore a stateful service in isolation and measure recovery time and data loss.
Load-test an application and verify capacity assumptions, limits and overload handling.
Build a service with ownership, SLOs, observability, tested recovery and documented trade-offs.
